description: Use when you need to reverse engineer an Android APK you are authorized to test, such as a client mobile application on a penetration test or a CTF challenge APK. Covers APK triage and acquisition, decompiling to readable Java with jadx 1.5.1, decoding resources and smali with apktool 2.11.0, AndroidManifest analysis, exported component and permission review, hardcoded secret and API key hunting, WebView and deep link attack surface mapping, and insecure storage patterns. Use when static analysis must come before dynamic testing, or when you cannot run the app and must read it.
